a2_clauses.orientation_covariance: the oriented seam difference is preserved under transported orientation and reverses sign when the seam orientation is reversed

presentation_invariance.theorem: finite register addition is commutative, so event presentation changes neither the count nor the settling cost, which factors through that count

claim_boundary: Exact operational-source mechanism on the pinned carrier: integer loads arise from atomic signed record transitions, the settling cost arises from the admissible repair dynamics, the mod-twelve congruence is a necessary consensus obstruction with an explicit source-generated on-fiber witness, the half-unit candidate is retained as a units rescaling, and the #625 quadratic is retained as a distinct typed object with exact separating witnesses. No particle, gauge, capacity, or measured-target label enters the source packet.
consumer_binding: downstream consumers of the counting normalization stay bound to the pinned #625 receipt, which this certificate names as its comparison-side source; the settling cost has no prior consumer and binds here

cost_separation.statement: the settling cost, seam quadratic, load-square Lyapunov function, and A3 Hessian are distinct objects. The two witnesses have the same load-square and the same 12I Hessian value but different settling costs; they also have different seam-quadratic values. The move-count cost is derived from the repair dynamics and is not an information Hessian

half_unit_complete_lift.statement: seam differences and repair increments scale by c, the event threshold two becomes 2c in displayed units, the admissible move graph and minimum move-count cost are unchanged, and rotation and refinement naturality commute with scaling

mechanism.counting_map: per-port register sums; integer image by atomicity
mechanism.event_grammar: append-only atomic signed events with checkpoints
mechanism.repair_move: conservative unit transfer across a seam with difference magnitude at least two
mechanism.seam_quadratic_role: separately typed A2 comparison observable; not a Lyapunov function
mechanism.seam_readback: oriented seam differences of the counting map
mechanism.settling_cost: minimum admissible-move count, exact breadth-first search

rows.reading: conservation forbids consensus for every schedule: a consensus state carries total twelve times its level
conservation forbids consensus for every schedule: a consensus state carries total twelve times its level
an explicit admissible schedule, replayed and re-verified at record level, reaches consensus from the source-generated full pile
rows.source_generation: twelve atomic +1 writes at port p00

fiber_obstruction.statement: divisibility by twelve is a necessary conserved condition for consensus, not a sufficient classification of all initial states; a source-generated on-fiber full pile has an explicit verified eighteen-move consensus schedule

schedule_exhaustion.statement: every maximal admissible schedule terminates in the settled set

theorems.settled_characterization: the settled set is exactly the configurations with every seam difference in {-1, 0, 1}

strict_descent.exact_delta: V(after) - V(before) = -2*(d - 1) for source-sink difference d >= 2
strict_descent.statement: every admissible move lowers V by at least two, so every schedule terminates; the separately typed seam quadratic can increase and is not used for termination

local_weight.source_note: a strictly positive constant A3 weight w multiplies the jet port-uniformly, so C becomes 6 w I and H becomes 12 w I; both stay on the identity ray. The absolute coefficients require unit local weight

objective.expansion: D(tau + eps v || tau) = eps sum_p v_p + eps^2 sum_p v_p^2 / (2 tau_p) + O(eps^3), by the exact jet of (tau_p + eps v)(log(1 + eps v / tau_p))

optimizer_to_dynamic_readback.domain: A3 optimizer on the fixed probability simplex

refinement_persistence.clause: the neutral A1 tower carries coherent incidence-preserving r0-to-r1, r1-to-r2, and r0-to-r2 port maps; counting and signed seam readback commute with all three
